proposals.evidence: DEDR5381 gives Tamil/Malayalam vān sky;4876 gives Tamil/Malayalam/Kota mīn star. LSI vānu minu Star is analysed as sky + star, preserving source order, final u on both members and the unmarked length of minu. Use the stellar/shining article4876 rather than the fish article merely because both have mīn forms.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3266 gives Tamil/Malayalam tī fire and Tulu tū/sū fire. LSI Irula ty has original tü and phonemic front rounded y; propose this fire family, also represented by the same survey’s earlier tī response. Preserve the rounded vowel and do not normalise it to i or treat y as a consonant.
